info.title: Cloudgate API
info.description: The REST API of a Cloudgate instance: everything the console does, for scripts and CI. Authenticate with a Personal key in the x-api-key header and name the Organization to act in with x-organization-id. On the Hosted instance the base URL is https://cloudgate.octabyte.app/backend; on a Self-hosted instance it is your console address followed by /backend. Request shapes are generated from the schemas the server validates against. Operator-only, webhook and internal routes are left out of this public copy. Reference: https://cloudgate.octabyte.io/docs/api

get.description: `open` is whether an uninvited sign-up is accepted now; `state` says which of the four `SignUpState`s that is, because the screen says different things for each: "Set up this instance" and "Already set up" when Self-hosted, "Not open yet" and the public form when Hosted.

200.description: Starts a CLI login: a code for the person to approve at /device, and the device code the CLI polls with. Takes no fields; in particular no user, so a code is bound only to whoever approves it.

The CLI's poll. Once the code is approved, a Personal key ending 90 days after login, answered once; until then a 400 whose code is AUTHORIZATION_PENDING, SLOW_DOWN, EXPIRED_TOKEN, ACCESS_DENIED or INVALID_GRANT.
